article.story: HUNTINGTON, W.Va. -- — Josh Beadle and AJ Dancier each scored 26 points as Coastal Carolina beat Marshall 85-83 on Wednesday. Beadle had seven rebounds for the Chanticleers (10-9, 3-4 Sun Belt Conference). Dancier shot 8 for 11 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 7 of 7 from the free-throw line. Rasheed Jones went 5 of 9 from the field (2 for 5 from 3-point range) to finish with 13 points. Noah Otshudi led the Thundering Herd (11-7, 3-3) in scoring, finishing with 30 points and four assists. Marshall also got 24 points and four assists from Jalen Speer. Wyatt Fricks finished with 11 points, six rebounds and two steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
